svg.title: Free Gaussian: density and probability flow
svg.desc: One-dimensional full line, V=0, m=1e-30 kg, s=1 nm, k0=1 per nm. Density and flow have separate vertical scales. At t=t0, x less than -2 nm has a small negative flow from spreading, retained on the full axis and enlarged using the same data.

g.text: Free Gaussian: density and probability flow
